QUEST I · PROLOGUE · Mumbai & New York

First Steps in the Capital

Quest giver: RSQUARE Media · Level range: 2018

Before the desert, before the manor, there was a first job in two cities, learning how a brand sounds on social media and how a team actually runs.

  • Strategized and created content for clients' digital assets
  • Oversaw content across two cities, Mumbai and New York
  • Led recruitment and onboarding for the social team
BOSS BATTLE

The Two-City Onboarding

Side encounter

Built a recruitment and onboarding process that worked whether the team was in Mumbai or New York.

2 cities1 team
Social Media Associate & Team Leader
QUEST II · MAIN QUEST · Editage & sibling brands

The Desert Trials

Quest giver: Cactus Communications · Level range: Aug 2018 – Nov 2022

Four years, three roles, one brand family: Cactus Communications, home of Editage. This is where I learned to survive on data, deadlines, and very good SEO. Every quest here came with a number attached.

  • Web Copywriter, UX/UI (Aug 2018–May 2020): web copy and SEO-first content across brands
  • Senior Writer, Content Marketing (May 2020–May 2022): engagement across email, social, video, and community
  • Senior Writer, New Client Acquisition (May 2022–Nov 2022): conversion-focused campaigns to win new clients
BOSS BATTLE

The SEO Ascent

Boss: ranking brand pages on Google

Rewrote service pages with keyword-rich content, FAQs, and on-page fixes until the brand ranked for real search terms, in both the US and India.

Rank 0 on Google#1 for 3 keywordsTop 2 on a 4th
BOSS BATTLE

The Repeat-Rate Trial

Boss: an email survey across three customer tribes

Split clients into Active, VIP, and Defected, and wrote tailor-made content with a coupon for taking part. One of the most successful surveys in the region since 2018.

389 responses in 10 days37 jobs won back26,835 emails sent

Boss: three videos, three markets

Conceptualized, scripted, and storyboarded remarketing videos for Japan, Korea, and the rest of the world.

QUEST III · SIDE QUEST · Remote

The Freelance Path

Quest giver: Text Inspector · Level range: 2022 – now

A side quest that's run alongside the main campaign: keyword-rich, well-researched blog content, built the same way every good piece should be, by studying the product and the reader's actual problem first.

  • Research the product and its customers' pain points before writing a word
  • Deliver SEO-minded blog content on an ongoing freelance basis
BOSS BATTLE

The Long Game

Ongoing encounter

A side quest with no end date yet, kept running in parallel with the main campaign since 2022.

QUEST IV · MAIN QUEST · Mumbai

The Main Campaign: Inside the Manor

Quest giver: 360 ONE · Level range: Mar 2023 – now

The current chapter. Senior Manager, Marketing, Branding, and Communications for wealth and asset management. More rooms than any quest before it: client letters, internal comms, media, publications, social, events, and the trophy room.

  • Lead the awards programme end to end, from pitch to final submission
  • Publish the annual outlook and turn it into a thought-leadership campaign
  • Build and ship 7,000+ pieces of content a year across every channel
  • Took the new wealth management website from 0 to 1: IA, tone, SEO, UX, content
BOSS BATTLE
